title: Progressive card pagination (10 cards + Load More) with dnd-kit persistence
author: agent-developer (react-tailwind-artisan)
summary: Implemented progressive card pagination for Kanban board columns defaulting to PAGE_SIZE = 10 cards. When a column contains more than 10 cards, renders a tactile hairline 'Загрузить еще' button with remaining card count. Preserved full dnd-kit drag-and-drop mechanics across paginated items.
